top.text: Anthropic realized that the ultimate premium product for professionals isn't just smarter text generation, it's time. ​A tool that writes a good email saves you 5 mins. A tool that navigates your entire desktop and executes a 15 step software workflow saves you an hour. (7/10)

top.author: @SysDrive_IT
top.text: Sending emails to coordinate schedules is hard. Next time you want to schedule a meeting with multiple people: Outlook has a built-in feature "Scheduling Polls". Instead of listing times, you insert a poll directly into the email. The recipients click options that work for them.
top.translationZh: 发邮件协调时间安排真的太难了。下次要和多人约会议时：Outlook有个内置功能叫"日程投票"。不用列一堆时间选项，直接在邮件里插个投票就行。收件人点击适合自己的时间就好了。

top.text: 今日も朝から書類整理。請求書テンプレ化→メール自動生成→承認フロー簡略化で3時間分の仕事が消えた。社長が本当にやるべきは「判断」だけ。定型業務は仕組み化する側に回ろう。これで一つ消えた。
